response.sql:
WITH filtered_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    balance,
    CASE 
      WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
      WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
    END AS signed_amount
  FROM trans
  WHERE amount > 2400
),
account_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    AVG(signed_amount) AS avg_signed,
    AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM filtered_trans
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_signed) AS overall_avg_signed,
  AVG(avg_balance) AS overall_avg_balance
FROM account_avgs
WHERE avg_signed IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: For the second figure (average balance), we use the same set of accounts as the first figure—only accounts with at least one PRIJEM or VYDAJ transaction exceeding 2400. The phrase 'accounts with no signed amount are skipped for the first figure' is interpreted as identifying which accounts to exclude from both figures. An alternative is that this exclusion applies only to the first figure.

alternatives.interpretation: Accounts with no signed amounts are skipped only for the first figure; the second figure (average balance) includes all accounts with any transaction > 2400, regardless of whether they have PRIJEM or VYDAJ transactions.
